## About

I'm building shared infrastructure for Malagasy products — identity first, because it's the layer everything else depends on.
Stack: Spring Boot, Next.js, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Python, Docker, OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, RS256, JWKS, PKCE.
